name: portfolio.optim
title: Mean-variance weights from quadprog.solve_qp. The covariance is the sample covariance.

origin.description: Mean-variance weights from quadprog.solve_qp. The covariance is the sample covariance.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: Mean-variance weights from quadprog.solve_qp. The covariance is the sample covariance.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
set.seed(3)
x <- matrix(rnorm(40), 10, 4) + 2
p <- portfolio.optim(x)
paste(join(p$pw), cell(p$pm), cell(p$ps), sep = "|")
